baseGitHub.role: published 1.7.7 repository state used as the base for the MailPin 1.7.8 maintenance candidate

invariants: No network, telemetry, ads, CDN or remote code
No message bodies or attachment contents stored
SQLite writes remain incremental, transactional and serialized
All injected resources are cleaned up
No remote publication without explicit approval
Privileged API inputs are bounded and normalized
Only exact MailPin-owned Thunderbird tags may be managed or removed
Optional Thunderbird capabilities fail locally instead of disabling the full extension
Business modules do not call Thunderbird core services directly outside compatibility adapters
Recommended mode never auto-saves and preserves profile-specific settings
Organic Workspace uses one canonical workspace stylesheet rather than stacked runtime patch stylesheets
Selected-account scope uses Thunderbird account.key consistently from Options through runtime filtering

security.thunderbirdBoundary: Messages/Tags/Calendar internals remain isolated behind dedicated compatibility adapters
security.uiDependencyPolicy: native HTML plus local Organic Workspace CSS tokens; canonical workspace stylesheet; no runtime patch stylesheet, npm runtime dependency, bundler, CDN or remote asset
security.runtimeTestSupplyChain: test-only Thunderbird/geckodriver downloads are checksum-verified and are not runtime dependencies

testing.browserStatus: MailPin 1.7.8 is a maintenance candidate for Thunderbird 153.0 through 155.*. Runtime behavior remains the validated 1.7.7 Thunderbird 155 implementation; the manifest/version bump must pass fresh exact-candidate gates before publication.
